CustomField.description: Admin-configured step INCREMENT for numeric fields (#254): drives the stepper's minus/plus buttons and the slider's granularity via flowFormField.stepIncrement. Deliberately NEVER applied as the native input step attribute, which validates typed values against multiples (step 1 would reject 10.50); the inputs keep the schema-derived step for validation. Stored as a raw number string like min__c/max__c; blank falls back to the schema-derived step.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How much the Stepper buttons and Slider move per step. Typed values are never restricted to multiples of this amount. Leave blank to step by the field's smallest decimal increment.
CustomField.label: step
